// Blood II's explosions, as a mod's Mod\Explosions.txt names them.
// GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables --dump explosions` from
// Blood2/Shared/BloodModExplosions.cpp; do not edit, regenerate.
//
// Retail's explosions are code (ClientShellDLL/ExplosionFX.cpp), so
// they are listed by name, not by piece.  A section is one's name with
// _HIGH, _MEDIUM or _LOW for a detail level, or none for all three; its
// Piece1 .. Piece64 are drawn after retail's, or instead with Replace =
// TRUE.  A name not below is a new explosion, which a projectile, weapon
// or script then names.  A piece is a kind and Field=value pairs:
//
//     [GRENADE_HIGH]
//     Piece1 = "Sprite Sprite=Sprites\smokepuff3.spr Offset=15 Normal=1 Duration=6 Alpha=0.85"
//
// Every kind also takes Offset, Normal (but a Light), NormalVector and
// Count.  A value is a number, a..b, <x,y,z>, a path, or for SpawnType
// and TrailType an EXP_ or OBJFX_ name.  Blood2/Shared/BloodModExplosions.h
// has the rest.

// The kinds and their fields:
//     Model: Offset Normal NormalVector Count Scale1 Scale2 Rotations Duration Alpha WaveForm FadeType RandomRot Model Skin Pick
//     Sprite: Offset Normal NormalVector Count Scale1 Scale2 Duration Alpha WaveForm FadeType Sprite Align Pick
//     Ring: Offset Normal NormalVector Count Duration Alpha FadeType Align Color Radius PosRadius Velocity Gravity Rotation Particles Delay RotateType Particle Pick
//     Light: Offset Count Duration Delay Color1 Color2 Radius1 Radius2
//     Frag: Offset Normal NormalVector Count Duration Model Skin Velocity Gravity Scale RotateMax Spread BounceMod FadeTime InitAlpha RandDir SpawnExp SpawnType TrailType Pick
//     Wave: Offset Normal NormalVector Count Scale1 Scale2 Duration Alpha WaveForm FadeType Align Delay Wave Pick
//     Flame: Offset Normal NormalVector Count Alpha FadeType Radius PosRadius Velocity Gravity Particles Delay Particle Color1 Color2 Color3 LifeTimes LifeOffsets FXTimes RampFlags Pick
